advisories.reason: Time-limited third-party wallet SDK risk acceptance (CVE-2023-54404, high): the DApp lockfile contains six nested zod 3.x copies pinned by @coinbase/cdp-sdk, @reown/appkit* and @walletconnect/utils, while root zod is 4.6.7. Upstream advisory flags all <4.6.6, with no patched zod 3 release. Avoid a forced zod 4 override that may break wallet schema behavior. scripts/check-zod.mjs MUST enforce the exact six legacy paths and versions, inspect imports, and keep ARL/x402 at patched zod >=4.6.6. Not a security fix; re-evaluate and remove promptly once wallet SDKs upgrade.
